purpose: Verify native dump capture and compare the controlled abort signature with the historical intermittent 0xC0000409 events. This is NOT a product crash dump and must not be presented as root-cause proof.
interpretation: ucrtbase+0xa527e with fastfail code 7 is the CRT abort()/fatal-app-exit path.
The historical WER reports listed the same offset, exception code and parameter 7.
This narrows the historical failures to an abort()/fatal-app-exit path; it does not identify the caller.
tests/conftest.py installs a SIGABRT handler, but os.abort() bypasses it on this Python/UCRT build (observed rc=3221226505 with no abort-capture output).
capture_method: Poll C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER\Temp for WER*.tmp.mdmp while the controlled child calls os.abort(), then copy the dump before WER removes it. The configured HKCU LocalDumps folder did not retain the dump.
